# Review Bundle v1 Fixture

This fixture is the canonical compiled review-bundle golden baseline for `comparevi-history`.

Source:

- synthetic single-target fixture generated by `scripts/CompareVIHistoryReviewBundleFixture.psm1`
- script under test: `Invoke-CompareVIHistoryReviewBundleCompiler.ps1`
- compiled engine: `src/CompareVIHistory.ReviewCompiler/`

Frozen contract expectations:

- the bundle stays pair-first instead of mode-first
- raw preview pairs remain available as debug evidence
- reviewer-canonical history pairs remain deterministic
- reviewer summary and change-detail interpretation stay stable for the synthetic fixture
- primary reviewer destinations remain pair-level and raw report paths remain debug-only

The golden contract test reads `review-bundle.json` and fails closed if the normalized compiled review bundle drifts
from this baseline.
